Ayahi Takagaki (Japanese: 高垣彩陽 Takagaki Ayahi) is a Japanese voice actress for .

==Biography==
Takagaki was born on October 25, 1985 in , and became an actress as an adult. She joined during where she voiced Kylie. She gained her most prominent role in , voicing Goh's friend and rival Horace.
